channel.title: Developer Messaging Lab
channel.description: The latest posts from Developer Messaging Lab

item.title: Hello World
item.description: The first sample post for this blog built with Hexo.

item.title: Microsoft Graph email attachments
item.description: Understand the file, item, inline, and cloud attachment types in Exchange Online when using Microsoft Graph.

item.title: Create a draft meeting with Microsoft Graph
item.description: Learn how to create a draft meeting with Microsoft Graph and send it when it is ready.

item.title: Debug Outlook Web Add-ins with Visual Studio
item.description: Learn how to debug Outlook Web Add-ins with Visual Studio using the procedure from 2019.

item.title: Capture Warning Output in Exchange Online PowerShell
item.description: Learn how to capture warning output from Exchange Online PowerShell with WarningVariable, and how this differed with Remote PowerShell connections.

item.title: Messaging APIs Available with Office 365
item.description: A 2018 overview of EWS, the Office 365 API (Outlook REST API), and Microsoft Graph for accessing Exchange Online mailboxes.

item.title: Sort Format-List Output by Property Name
item.description: Learn how to display command results in Format-List sorted by property name and use the Format-SortedList function.

item.title: Inspecting the Contents of Export-TransportRuleCollection
item.description: Learn how to export Exchange Server transport rules to XML and inspect the output of Export-TransportRuleCollection.

item.title: Check delegate and private calendar permissions with PowerShell
item.description: Learn how to check calendar delegate settings and permissions to view private items with Exchange Online PowerShell.

item.title: Default Output of Remote PowerShell Commands
item.description: See how to inspect the default output of Get-Mailbox in Exchange Online Remote PowerShell and change its format with Export-PSSession.

item.title: Under the Hood: Exchange Online PowerShell with MFA
item.description: An investigation of how Exchange Online PowerShell connected with MFA in 2017, including its use of OAuth tokens and Remote PowerShell.

item.title: Data Types in the Exchange Management Shell and Remote PowerShell
item.description: See how ModerateMessageByUser, the list of transport rule moderators, has different data types and element-count behavior in the Exchange Server Management Shell and remote PowerShell.

item.title: GetRoomLists and GetRooms limitations
item.description: Learn how many room lists and rooms EWS returns, with a C# example tested against a room list containing 110 members.

item.title: Change the PowerShell Prompt
item.description: Customize the PowerShell prompt to show the current time, add color, or put a long path on its own line.

item.title: Convert Between Exchange Server Version Numbers and Product Names
item.description: Use Get-ExchangeBuildNumber and Get-ExchangeProductName to convert between Exchange Server product names and version numbers, and learn how the tool checks for definition file updates.

item.title: Get Outlook calendar shortcuts with EWS
item.description: Learn how to retrieve shared calendar shortcuts from Outlook or OWA with EWS and which MAPI properties store the information.

item.title: How long does In-Place Hold take to apply?
item.description: Learn why changing an In-Place Hold or Litigation Hold setting in Exchange Server may take up to 60 minutes to apply to a mailbox.

item.title: Create an Exchange Online mailbox with Microsoft Graph
item.description: Learn how to create a user with Microsoft Graph and assign a Microsoft 365 license to provision an Exchange Online mailbox.

item.title: Change the message class with EWS
item.description: Learn why changing a message class with EWS can cause ObjectTypeChangedException and how to work around it by copying MimeContent.

item.title: Outlook.com and Exchange Online integration
item.description: A record of the Outlook.com and Exchange Online integration and the Outlook REST API support available at the time.
